title: 第7章 美人一笑血海飘香第8章 长记性
slug: 梦中强吻女帝被找上门了怎么办
content_zh:
广场上人来人往，十分热闹。
耳边的人声越来越嘈杂，江晨为了维持神通，消耗的精神也越来越多，额头渗出细密的汗水。
银色脚印继续往前。
江晨走了几步，忽然睁开眼睛。
他感受到了一股“恶意”，阴森森的，似乎有人在暗处盯着自己。
那种眼神十分恶毒，以至于激起了江晨的本能警觉。
紧接着，江晨闻到一股香风。
这股香风沁人心脾，如同春日里的小雨，细密缠绵，又若豆蔻少女的情丝，温柔缱绻，让人深陷其中，如痴如醉。
江晨一抬头，就见一个面若芙蓉、身材曼妙的白衣女子主动迎上来，朝他露出妩媚的笑容。
“小哥，今天天气不错，一起去喝一杯吗？”
附近的男人们都投来嫉妒的目光，小声嘀咕这林仙子的眼光也太差了吧，怎么会看上这种稚嫩的小家伙？
更让人大跌眼镜的是，那小子居然拒绝了，理由是：“没钱。”
周围顿时传来一片嘘声，不少人跟着起哄，那位林仙子的脸上顿时有些挂不住了，重重哼道：“小弟弟，这么多人看着呢，不能给姐姐一个面子吗？姐姐请客，这总行吧？”
江晨歉意地笑了笑：“改天吧，今天实在没空。”
他一眼就看出来，这林仙子不是什么好东西，很可能是仙人跳、酒托一类的角色，懒得理会。
江晨的目光漫不经心地扫过广场，搜寻那股恶意的来源。
“你在等人？”林仙子自来熟地走到他身边，“反正我也闲着，就陪你一起等吧。”
江晨却往旁边挪开一步，道：“抱歉，你在这儿……有点不方便。”
“怎么不方便了，难道你等的人是个姑娘？”
“没错……”江晨往广场上扫视一眼，随便挑了个人多的方向，顺手一指，“她在那边办事，很快就回来。”

林仙子顺着他指的方向望去，脸上笑容变得有些不自然：“你说的是那位穿翠绿色长裙的姑娘？”
广场上最引人注目的，是一位穿着翠绿色长裙的美丽少女，她的面容如白瓷玉偶一般精致，让人不忍移开视线。几个自命风流的公子哥已围上去争相搭讪，大献殷勤，更多人则在附近驻足观望。
与那翠衣少女比起来，就算是妩媚性感的林仙子，也显得相形见绌。
林仙子甚至觉得，就算是“西辽城第一美人”冬雪，只怕也比不上这翠衣少女。
江晨点点头：“对，我等的人就是她。”
林仙子望望那少女，又看看江晨，狐疑道：“你们俩真的认识吗？不会是在骗我吧？”
江晨面不改色地道：“不骗你，我跟她是青梅竹马的好朋友……”
话没说完，人群中的翠衣少女忽然转过头，露出一个明艳绝伦的笑容。
江晨的心跳霎时漏了一拍，呼吸也几乎凝窒了。
并非因为惊艳，而是一种毛骨悚然的恐怖之感。
他瞧清了那翠衣少女的面容，与昨晚梦中的“万妖宫主”，竟有七八分相似！
是她？
昨晚的那个邪祟？
她没有躺在棺材里，等着本少侠去刨坟，而是就这么堂而皇之的、在大白天现身？
“你等着吧！我会来找你的——”
梦中“万妖宫主”愤怒不甘的叫喊，仿佛又在江晨耳边回响。
我正要去追踪她的脚印，她却主动找上门来了？
长得这么像，不是巧合吧？
content_en:
The square was very lively with people coming and going.
The voices in his ears became more and more noisy. In order to maintain his magical power, Jiang Chen expended more and more energy, and beads of sweat broke out on his forehead.
The silver footprints continue forward.
Jiang Chen walked a few steps and suddenly opened his eyes.
He felt a sense of "malice", which was eerie, as if someone was staring at him in the dark.
That look was so vicious that it aroused Jiang Chen's instinctive vigilance.
Immediately afterwards, Jiang Chen smelled a fragrant breeze.
This fragrant wind is refreshing, like the light rain in spring, fine and lingering, and like the love thread of a cardamom girl, gentle and lingering, making people fall deeply into it and become intoxicated.
As soon as Jiang Chen raised his head, he saw a woman in white with a face like a hibiscus and a graceful figure approaching him, smiling charmingly at him.
"Brother, the weather is nice today. Would you like to go have a drink together?"
The men nearby cast jealous glances and whispered that Fairy Lin's taste was too bad. How could she fall in love with such a naive little guy?
What was even more surprising was that the boy actually refused, citing the reason: "No money."
Suddenly there was a boo from the surrounding area, and many people started to boo. Immediately, Fairy Lin lost her composure and hummed loudly: "Little brother, with so many people watching, can't you give your sister some face? Is this the head office where you can treat me to a treat?"
Jiang Chen smiled apologetically: "Let's do it another day, I really don't have time today."
He could tell at a glance that Fairy Lin was not a good person. She was probably a fairy dancing or a wine bearer, and he was too lazy to pay attention to her.
Jiang Chen's eyes swept across the square casually, searching for the source of the malice.
"Are you waiting for someone?" Fairy Lin walked to him in a familiar manner, "I'm free anyway, so I'll wait with you."
Jiang Chen took a step aside and said, "Sorry, it's a little inconvenient for you to be here."
"Why is it inconvenient? Is the person you are waiting for a girl?"
"That's right..." Jiang Chen glanced at the square, randomly picked a direction with a lot of people, and pointed, "She's doing business over there and will be back soon."
Fairy Lin looked in the direction he pointed, and the smile on her face became a little unnatural: "Are you talking about the girl in the emerald green dress?"
The most eye-catching thing on the square is a beautiful girl wearing an emerald green dress. Her face is as delicate as a white porcelain jade doll, making people unable to bear to look away. Several self-proclaimed romantic young men have gathered around to chat with him and show their hospitality, while more people are standing nearby to watch.
Compared with the girl in green clothes, even the charming and sexy Lin Fairy pales in comparison.
Fairy Lin even felt that even Dong Xue, the "most beautiful woman in Xiliao City", could not compare to this girl in green clothes.
Jiang Chen nodded: "Yes, she is the one I am waiting for."
Fairy Lin looked at the girl, then at Jiang Chen, and asked suspiciously, "Do you two really know each other? Are you lying to me?"
Jiang Chen said without changing his expression: "I'm not going to lie to you, she and I are childhood sweethearts..."
Before he finished speaking, the girl in green clothes in the crowd suddenly turned her head and showed a bright smile.
Jiang Chen's heartbeat skipped a beat, and his breathing was almost suffocated.
Not because it was amazing, but because it felt eerie and terrifying.
He could clearly see that the face of the girl in green clothes was very similar to the "Master of the Palace of Ten Thousand Demons" in his dream last night!
Is it her?
That evil spirit last night?
She didn't lie in the coffin, waiting for me to dig the grave, but just showed up in broad daylight like this?
"Just wait! I will come to you -"
The angry and unwilling shouts of the "Master of the Palace of Ten Thousand Demons" in the dream seemed to echo in Jiang Chen's ears again.
I was just about to follow her footprints, but she came to the door?
It's not a coincidence that they look so similar, right?
